title: AFRL RISE 2808a AOI: Facility Alteration & Space Optimization – Bombers Directorate Hallway Project (Bldg 556)
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND > AIR FORCE RESEARCH LABORATORY > FA8652 AFRL HQ AFRL/PK
description:
T his Area of Interest (AOI) is issued under the Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) Rapid Infrastructure for Science and Experimentation ('RISE') parent notice FA8652279-RISE pursuant to 10 U.S.C. § 2808a. Refer to the attached AOI document and attachments for submission instructions, technical requirements, and assessment criteria.  

 To optimize the work environment and facility functionality for personnel in the 2nd Floor hallway of Building 556, Acquisition Management Complex, Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio. This project transforms an existing standard entrance hallway into a modern, motivating environment that reinforces the strategic deterrence mission and heritage of the USAF Bombers community through bomber-specific environmental wall graphics, heraldry shields, structural scale models, historical elements, painting, architectural finishes, decals, and visual enhancement using existing space and structures. 

 Target Timeline: The entire project must be completed within ninety (90) calendar days of award: Stage 1 Design Plan (30 days), Stage 2 Sourcing & Fabrication (60 days), and Stage 3 Physical Implementation & Closeout (90 days). On-site physical installation shall not exceed thirty (30) calendar days from physical site commencement and shall not restrict access to 2nd Floor restroom facilities for more than thirty (30) contiguous minutes.
